name: STM Physical AI Power Infrastructure and SiC Valuation
rationale: STMicroelectronics N.V. (STM) is a leader in high-voltage 800V DC server rack power distribution and Catania 200mm SiC semiconductor manufacturing. TTM revenue reached $11.8B (+26.1% YoY). At $48.78 (forward P/E 19.20x), our 5-year DCF yields a fair value of $93.19 (+91.0% upside at 9.10% WACC). Reverse DCF indicates the market is pricing in just 5.3% CAGR, well below our 16.5% base case. Recommendation: ACCUMULATE (Core Holding: 24.0 shares, 3.69% target weight). Accumulate on dips near $47.22, trim Tier 1 at $80.00+.

bear.rationale: Slower European EV demand and price compression in commodity Silicon Carbide (SiC) limits Year 5 revenue to $17.3B.
risks: Chinese domestic SiC wafer competition eroding automotive gross margins

base.rationale: AI datacenter 800V DC power architectures (NVIDIA MGX 12kW GaN/SiC) and Catania 200mm fab drive $25.3B revenue at 19.5% margin.
risks: Catania fab ramp yield friction and depreciation drag

bull.rationale: STMicro dominates physical AI power semiconductor market and humanoid actuator chips; $34.6B revenue at 24% net margin.
risks: European regulatory energy cost shocks on domestic fab operations
